svg.title: Map Outposts
svg.desc: A solid dot for home and an open ring set apart from it on the diagonal: a place outside the repository that home supplies by hand and cannot write. Drawn in one ink on the budget-drs app icon's box and rules, for the page to paint in its text colour: solid, no strokes, and every gap at least 2.5 units, which is about 1.4 CSS pixels at 16.
